Drop all-NA data rows from the output table

Source: R/collect_tern_data.R
dot-filter_na_rows.Rd

When na.rm is TRUE and data columns are present, removes rows where every data column is NA.

Usage

.filter_na_rows(out, data_cols, na.rm)

Arguments

out

A data.table containing the collected data.

data_cols

A character vector of column names to check (excludes date, lon, lat).

na.rm

Logical. If TRUE, drop all-NA rows.

Value

A (possibly filtered) data.table.
